definitions.explanation: The Japanese government ministry in charge of the legal system: prosecutors, prisons, immigration control (through the Immigration Services Agency), nationality, family registers, and the registration of land and companies. Its head is the {法務大臣|ほうむだいじん}, the Minister of Justice.

examples.japanese: {法務省|ほうむしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The Ministry of Justice made an announcement.

examples.japanese: {法務省|ほうむしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入国管理|にゅうこくかんり}→入国管理：23967_nyuukokukanri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}している→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: The Ministry of Justice is reviewing the immigration control system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{死刑|しけい}→死刑：13200_shikei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{執行|しっこう}→執行：18996_shikkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{法務大臣|ほうむだいじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Executions are carried out on the order of the Minister of Justice.

notes:
One of the ⟦{省|しょう}→〜省：32472_shou⟧ (ministries) of the national government, like ⟦{外務省|がいむしょう}→外務省：31654_gaimushou⟧ and ⟦{財務省|ざいむしょう}→財務省：31534_zaimushou⟧. In the news it is often named for immigration matters, since the Immigration Services Agency ({出入国在留管理庁|しゅつにゅうこくざいりゅうかんりちょう}, ⟦{入管|にゅうかん}→入管：32014_nyuukan⟧) is under it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法務大臣|ほうむだいじん} / {法相|ほうしょう}: Minister of Justice
- {法務省|ほうむしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: an announcement by the Ministry of Justice
- {法務省|ほうむしょう}⟦{入国管理局|にゅうこくかんりきょく}→入国管理局：24934_nyuukokukanrikyoku⟧: the former Immigration Bureau (before 2019)

RELATED WORDS:
- {法務|ほうむ}: legal affairs; a company's {法務部|ほうむぶ} is its legal department
